PRIVACY POLICY
This privacy policy was last updated on September 18th, 2026
Privacy Policy Change History
This privacy policy (“Privacy Policy”) explains how TapBlaze, LLC (“Company”, “We", or “TapBlaze”) collects, stores, uses and shares information, including personal data and non-personal data, in connection with its online products, services and websites including, but not limited to TapBlaze’s games (together, “Services”). Please read this Privacy Policy carefully so that you understand our information practices. If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy Policy, please do not use the Services.
For more information about how we collect, store, use, and share the personal data of children under the age of 16, see
Section 3
.
TapBlaze is a valid licensee, and participating member, of the Entertainment Software Rating Board’s
Privacy Certified Program
(“ESRB Privacy Certified”). To help protect your privacy, we have voluntarily undertaken this privacy initiative. As a licensee in this privacy certification program, we are subject to frequent audits of our Services and other enforcement and accountability mechanisms administered independently by ESRB Privacy Certified. Our Services containing the ESRB Privacy Certified seal have been reviewed, and certified, by ESRB to meet established online information collection and use practices.

3. Policy Regarding Children
TapBlaze applies special protections for the personal data of:
players identified as under the age of 16 through an age gate (in those games that have one), and
all players in games without an age gate.
TapBlaze does not collect, use, or disclose such players’ personal data for profiling, personalized advertising, or geolocation tracking. We use only limited types of personal data, such as the persistent identifiers listed in the chart below (sometimes in combination with the data described in
Section 2
), for the following purposes:
To deliver the game and access network features
To provide you with the products and services you request
To serve contextual advertising based on the content of the game you are playing (including frequency capping, fraud prevention, and attribution)
To maintain and analyze game functionality
To detect, investigate and prevent actions to ensure legal and regulatory compliance
To protect the security and integrity of our online services and the safety of our users
The following table sets forth, for each category of personal information we collect from children, the purpose / business need and the retention period.
Personal data

Deleted promptly after fulfillment of request, unless it is reasonably necessary to retain the record to resolve the support inquiry fully. In such circumstances, TapBlaze will retain such records until the purpose for retention no longer exists or for a maximum time period of up to one (1) year from the date of the communication.
We use technical and contractual measures to limit our service providers and third parties with whom we share personal data from using such information for any other purpose. We work only with selected ad networks (defined in
Ad Serving Technology
section) that respect the tag-for-child-directed (TFCD) parameter—aka the ‘COPPA flag’—on a per-app or per-request basis for contextual advertising, so that interest-based advertising is switched off, and personal data collection is restricted. In addition, these ad networks are able to categorize and tag their ad creatives by age, so that the ads are appropriate content-wise.
Because we don’t collect or use the personal data of players under the age of 16 (except as set forth above), they are not able to make their personal data publicly available through our games.
If TapBlaze discovers that we have inadvertently gathered personal information from a child under 16 years of age, we will take reasonable measures to promptly delete such personal information from our records.
Please note that our customer support features are meant for players 16 years of age or older.

If we receive a customer support inquiry from a player that is under the age of 16, we will delete all personal information (e.g., name, email, etc.) immediately after fulfilling the request.
We do not retain children’s personal data indefinitely.
If you are a parent or legal guardian of a child under the age of 16 who uses TapBlaze's services and have any questions or comments, please contact us at
privacy@tapblaze.com
. If you are a parent or guardian, you may review the information we have collected from your child or ask us to make no further use of, or delete, such information. If you believe that we might have any personal data from or about a child under the age of 16, please contact us
here
. We may need to verify your identity before implementing your request. If we need to verify your identity, we will only ask for the minimum information necessary to do so.
Please note that in-game advertising for users under the age of sixteen (16) are only CONTEXTUAL.
The third-party ad networks which may display contextual advertisements to users under the age sixteen (16) are listed in
Appendix D
.

4-2. Third Party Account Data
Registration is not required in order to use or access our Services. However, if you are aged 16 or over, you may optionally use a third-party single sign-on (SSO) service to enjoy additional features.
Please note that, if you choose to use an SSO to access our Services, certain features of the Services may be able to connect to your social networking accounts to obtain additional information about you. In such cases, TapBlaze may be able to collect certain information from your social networking profile when the social networking site permits it, and when you consent to allow your social networking account to make that information available to TapBlaze.
The personal data we collect when you login via a third-party account (such as Apple, Google or Facebook) may depend on your privacy settings for that third-party account. We don’t control how such third parties collect, use and share your personal data. You should review the relevant third-party privacy policy for more information.
This information may include, but is not limited to:
(i) Profile: We may collect your name, profile picture, gender, user ID, email address, country, language, time zone, the organizations and links on your profile page, the names and profile pictures of your “friends”, and other information you have included in your social networking account profile;
(ii) Purchases: If you make a purchase within the Services through the relevant store, we may collect and maintain your purchase history and details, however, we do not receive your credit card number;
(iii) Customer Service: We may collect emails, chat records, attachments and customer opinions for customer consultation, handling complaints and other business, delivering announcements, and performing customer support tasks;
(iv) Other Automatically Collected Info: Device Identifiers. We may collect IP information for geolocation purposes, advertising ID, or other identifiers.
We may keep third party account data for a period of up to 2 years or until the user’s de-registration from the Services, or upon receiving a data deletion request from the user.
4-3. Third Party Data Collection and Use of End-User Information
When you use or connect to a TapBlaze website or download a TapBlaze mobile application by or through a third-party platform —including Facebook—you allow us to access and/or collect certain information from your Third Party Platform profile/account.
We will share some of the information we collect from you with vendors and other service providers who work with us to support the internal operations of our website and/or mobile application.
You can opt-out of third-party ad tracking and analytics by checking the privacy settings of your Android or iOS device and turning off “Allow Apps to Request to Track” or selecting "Limit Ad Tracking" (Apple iOS) or "Opt-out of Interest Based Ads" (Android). In addition, please ensure your game settings are set to "Data Opt Out".

Your choice to opt out of third party ad tracking and analytics services does not limit our ability to email you or collect other information.
Third Parties Data Sources:
See the section on
“Analytics and Attribution Technology”
below.
4-4. Website Log Files and Cookies
Our website utilizes industry standard analytic packages which gather limited information on visitors to our website automatically, and stores this information in server log files. This information may include IP addresses, browser type, basic IP information, referring pages, operating system used and date/time stamps, device properties (model, service provider information, OS information, language and country information), device software platform and firmware, mobile phone carrier, general geolocation data, and game activity and achievements (scores, credits, access logs, improper usage record and fraud detection information). TapBlaze also collects other information as reasonably required by TapBlaze to enhance the Services and other TapBlaze products and services such as domain name and other statistical or technical information related to your device.
4-5. Ad Serving Technology
For certain of our applications that allow users under the age of sixteen (16), TapBlaze has implemented age gates to verify the age of players. When you download our game, we collect your age as indicated by you. We provide a separate experience for users under the age sixteen (16) through which we collect limited information and serve contextual advertising only. In that experience, there will be no profiling, targeted advertising, or geolocation tracking, and we use the limited information we do collect to support our internal operations.
Mobile games and applications that are not directed to children under the age of sixteen (16) (“General Apps”) may collect a unique device ID or advertising ID (Apple Identifier for Advertisers (“IDFA”) on Apple devices and Google Advertising Identity (“GAID”) on Android devices) and combine it with information about your location and online activities across different services to infer your interests and deliver targeted advertisements that are relevant to you. If you opt out of data collection and sharing in a game, you will receive contextual advertising only.
If you click on any of these advertisements, the advertisers may use cookies and other tracking technologies to collect data regarding advertisement performance, your interaction with such ads and your interests (which may include device and network information, unique identifiers, gender, age and geolocation). When you engage with our games via your mobile device, you may be able to limit targeted advertising through your device settings. Please see your device manufacturer’s instructions for more information.
Please also see the
“Your Data Rights and Choices”
section, below, for more information on other ways you may limit targeted advertising. Refer to
Appendix D
for a list of the advertising networks we have contracted with and their respective privacy policies.
4-6. Analytics and Attribution Technology
We use third-party analytics services in our games to collect and analyze usage information through cookies and similar tools; engage in auditing, research, or reporting; assist with fraud prevention; and provide certain features to you. To prevent us from using your information for analytics, you may contact us as set forth in the
“Your Data Rights and Choices”
section below.
To find users for some of our games, we use paid advertising. To track which ads lead to installs or in-app purchases, we partner with attribution providers.
Please see the
“Your Data Rights and Choices”
section, below, for information on ways you may limit analytics. Refer to
Appendix D
for a list of the analytics and attribution technology providers we have contracted with and their respective privacy policies.

5. Disclosure and Transfer of Your Information
TapBlaze may use third party service providers such as credit card processors, e-mail service providers, shipping agents, data analyzers and business intelligence providers. TapBlaze may disclose your information as necessary to these third parties so they can provide services for TapBlaze. TapBlaze is not liable for the acts and omissions of these third parties, except as required by law.
TapBlaze may hire agents and contractors to collect and process your information on our behalf. We require them to comply with our Privacy Policy and to use your information only for the purposes of providing services to us. They may not use your information for their own marketing.
TapBlaze may disclose your information to third parties as required by law enforcement or other government officials in connection with an investigation of fraud, intellectual property infringements, or other activity that is illegal or may expose you or TapBlaze to legal liability. TapBlaze may also disclose your information to third parties when TapBlaze has a reason to believe that a disclosure is necessary to address potential or actual injury or interference with TapBlaze’s rights, property, operations, users or others who may be harmed or may suffer loss or damage, or TapBlaze believes that such disclosure is necessary to protect TapBlaze’s rights, combat fraud and/or comply with a judicial proceeding, court order, or legal process served on TapBlaze.
5-1. International Data Transfer
Information we collect may be transferred to countries outside your home country for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. These countries, including but not limited to the United States may not provide the same level of data privacy protection as the European Union (EU), European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom (UK), or your home country. You hereby expressly consent to the transfer of your information to these countries for processing in accordance with this Privacy Policy. These transfers are essential to the provision of our Services and performance of the Terms of Service.

6. Your Data Rights and Choices
You have certain rights to make choices about how we collect, use, or share your personal data as described below:
(1) Marketing Communications:
You can unsubscribe from marketing emails we send to you by clicking the “unsubscribe” link they contain or by contacting us
here
. Please note that even though you may opt-out of receiving marketing-related communications from us, we may still send you important administrative and transactional messages.
(2) Rights Regarding Your Information:
Depending on where you live, you may have the right, in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection laws, to make requests related to your personal data. Specifically, you may have the right to ask us to:
Inform you about the categories of personal data we collect or disclose about you; the categories of sources of such information; the business or commercial purpose for collecting your personal data; the categories of third parties with whom we disclose personal data; and, in certain states, like California, Minnesota, and Oregon, the specific third parties to whom we disclose personal information.
Provide you access to and/or a copy of certain personal data we hold about you.
Correct or update personal data we hold about you.
Delete certain personal data we have about you.
Provide you with information about the financial incentives that we offer to you, if any.
Restrict or object to certain uses of your information.
Opt you out of the processing of your personal data for purposes of profiling in furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects, if applicable.
Certain information may be exempt from such requests under applicable law. For example, we need certain information in order to provide the Services to you. We may also need to take reasonable steps to verify your identity before responding to a request, which may include, at a minimum, depending on the sensitivity of the information you are requesting and the type of request you are making, verifying your email address. If we are unable to verify you, we may be unable to respond to your requests.
To exercise any of these rights, you can email us at
privacy@tapblaze.com
, visit our website
here
and complete the webform, or use the support option in our games to exercise your rights. See also
Appendix A
(for users in the U.S.) and
Appendix B
(for users in the EEA and UK).
You may be able to designate an authorized agent to make requests on your behalf. In order for an authorized agent to be verified, you must provide the authorized agent with signed, written permission to make such requests or a power of attorney. We may also follow up with you to verify your identity before processing the authorized agent’s request.
Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to appeal our decision to deny your request, if applicable. We will provide information about how to exercise that right in our response denying the request. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
(3) Notice of Right to Opt Out of Sales of Personal Information and Processing/Sharing of Personal Information for Targeted Advertising Purposes:
Depending on where you live, you may also have the right to opt out of “sales” of your information and the “sharing” of your information for targeted advertising.
As explained in the
“Disclosure and Transfer of Your Information”
section above, we sometimes disclose information to unaffiliated third parties we collaborate with or that provide offers that we think may be of value to you. We also provide information to third-party advertising providers for targeted advertising purposes or use analytics partners to assist us in analyzing use of our Services and our user/customer base. Under certain laws, such disclosures may be considered a “sale” of personal information or the “sharing” of personal information for targeted advertising purposes.

If you would like to opt out of the disclosure of your personal information for purposes that could be considered “sales” for those third parties' own commercial purposes, or “sharing” for purposes of targeted advertising, please send an email to
privacy@tapblaze.com
. Note that you will need to opt out on each device you use to access the Services.
For residents in the USA and EEA/UK, please find further information in
Appendix A
and
Appendix B
, respectively.

7. Data Security and Integrity
The security, integrity, and confidentiality of your information are important to us. We have implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security measures that are designed to protect your information from unauthorized access, disclosure, use and modification. Please be aware though that, despite our best efforts, no security measures are perfect or impenetrable.

8. Data Retention
We will retain your information for the length of time needed to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, usually no more than two years, unless a longer retention period is required for the establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims, or for legitimate business purposes, or as provided by law. We set out more specific time frames for deletion in the chart below and in our written children’s data retention policy in
Section 3
. We take reasonable steps intended to implement technical, administrative, and physical security measures that are designed to protect your information from unauthorized access, disclosure, use and modification. Please be aware though that, despite our best efforts, no security measures are perfect or impenetrable.
We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you the Services. We will, for example, periodically de-identify unused game accounts and we regularly review and de-identify unnecessary data. We may keep idle information and third party data for a period of up to 2 years or until your de-registration from the Service, or the termination of entrustment agreement with the service provider. 9. Third-Party Links
Our website and apps may contain links to other sites or apps that we do not control. Please be aware of this when you click on any such links; we are not responsible for the privacy practices and/or policies of any website or app other than our own. Consequently, we strongly suggest that you review the privacy policy of every website or app you visit, whether or not they are linked to by our own site or app.

10. Changes to this Privacy Policy
We may revise this Privacy Policy at any time and we will update this Privacy Policy with any revisions. If TapBlaze makes material changes to this Privacy Policy or its privacy and data security practices, TapBlaze will post a notice on TapBlaze’s website along with the updated Privacy Policy as well as add an indicator on the link to the Privacy Policy inside the app. By continuing to access or use the Services after those changes become effective, you acknowledge and accept that your data will be handled in accordance with the revised Privacy Policy.

11. How to Contact Us
If you have any questions or concerns regarding this privacy policy, or you wish to contact us, you may do so
here

Appendix A – U.S. Residents
Note: The following additional information applies to you only if you reside in the U.S.:
Please contact

NOTICE FOR U.S. RESIDENTS OUTSIDE OF CALIFORNIA
If you reside in certain states, including Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah or Virginia, you may have, or you may soon have, the following rights under the privacy laws of your state, subject to the conditions under applicable laws:
* To confirm whether or not we collect your personal information and obtain copies of it (in some cases, in a portable format);
* To correct inaccuracies in the personal information we hold about you, taking into account the nature of the personal information and the purposes for which we use it;
* To delete personal information that we hold about you;
* To opt out of our use of your personal information for the purposes of targeted advertising.
Our websites do not collect analytics or any personal information and therefore do not respond to opt-out preference signals communicated via the Global Privacy Control. Further, your use of our websites is not tied to your use of our games. You must opt out of each game individually. Opting out of targeted ads does not mean that you will no longer see ads because we may still deliver contextual ads to you.
* To opt out of the sale of your personal data. We share your personal information with third parties for targeted advertising purposes, which some states may consider “selling” of personal information. You can opt out by:
(i) Emailing us at
privacy@tapblaze.com
;
(ii) Visiting our website and completing the webform
here
;
(iii) Using the
Data Opt Out
option in our games.
* To opt out of profiling in furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects concerning you. We do not engage in such profiling.
* If you reside in certain states, like California, Minnesota, and Oregon, you may have the right to request from us a list of the specific third parties, other than individuals, to whom we have disclosed your personal data or any personal data.
You may submit a request to exercise your rights by contacting us at
privacy@tapblaze.com
. If we decline to take action on a request exercising one of your rights set forth above, you may have the right to appeal our decision. In these cases, we will notify you providing our reasons for denying the request and instructions for how you can appeal the decision.

To the extent we can determine the value of your information, we consider the value to you (and costs to us) of providing you with a discount or other service, as compared to the value to us in an opportunity to gain a loyal, or even more loyal, customer; we seek to reasonably relate the benefits to you to the costs to us.
Sensitive Personal Information
The CCPA also allows you to limit our use or disclosure of your “sensitive personal information” (as defined in the CCPA) if your sensitive personal information is used for certain purposes. In the limited circumstances that we process sensitive personal information as defined in the CCPA (such as usernames in combination with passwords), we do not use or disclose it other than for disclosed and permitted business purposes for which there is not a right to limit under the CCPA.
How to Exercise Your Rights
If you are a California resident seeking to exercise your CCPA rights, please (i) email us at
privacy@tapblaze.com
, (ii) visit our website
here
and complete the webform, or (iii) use the support option in our games to contact us to exercise your rights under the CCPA. Please follow these instructions when contacting us for CCPA:
Tell us which game and which right(s) you wish to exercise. Under CCPA, you have the right to "Access your personal information", "Request deletion of your personal information", "Obtain additional details regarding TapBlaze's information practices."
We may ask you to provide additional personal information so that we can properly identify you in our dataset and to track compliance with your opt-out request. We will only use personal information provided in an opt-out request to review and comply with the request. If you choose not to provide this information, we may only be able to process your request to the extent we are able to identify you in our data systems and authenticate you as authorized to receive the information.
Retention of Your Personal Information. Please see the
“Data Retention”
section above.

RIGHTS
Users in the EEA and UK have rights in relation to the personal information. Some of these only apply in certain circumstances. We have described these situations below, as well as how you can exercise your rights. To exercise any of your rights, please email
privacy@tapblaze.com
.
* Access: to enquire about and access personal data held by TapBlaze and details about how we use it and who we share it with;
* Portability: in certain circumstances, you have the right to receive or ask us to provide your personal data to a third party in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format;
* Correction: to correct any personal data held about you that is inaccurate and have incomplete data completed;
* Erasure: that we erase your personal data in certain circumstances;
* Restriction of Processing to Storage Only: to require us to stop processing the personal data we hold about you other than for storage purposes in certain circumstances;
* Objection: in certain circumstances, the right to restrict or object to our processing of your personal data. You also have the right to object to marketing based on profiling;
* Withdrawing Consent: You can withdraw your consent at any time by (i) emailing us at

, (ii) visit our website

and complete the webform, or (iii) use the Data Opt Out option in our games;
* Complaints: if you wish to make a complaint about how we process your information, please email

and we will deal with your request as soon as possible. This is without prejudice to your right to launch a claim with your local data protection authority.
Appendix C – South Korea Users
Note for users in South Korea: The procedure and method of personal information destruction for users located in South Korea are as follows:
* Destruction procedure: The Company selects the personal information for which the reason for destruction occurred, and destroys the personal information with the approval of the person in charge of personal information protection.
* Destruction method: The company destroys personal information stored in the form of electronic files so that the record cannot be reproduced, and in the case of other records, printed materials, writing, or recording devices, it is destroyed by crushing or incineration with a shredder.

section, we provide a separate experience for younger users that limits advertising to contextual ads.
